**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/03/27 (Mon) 00:49
- [USER] User will ask a series of questions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User requested answers to questions based on a provided text about Wudhu (Ablution).
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] The text provided by the user includes detailed instructions on how to perform Wudhu, including the steps, fardh acts, sunnah acts, and mustahab acts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The person making Wudhu should face the qiblah and sit on an elevated place to prevent water from splashing on them.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Bismillahir Rahmânir Raheem should be recited when commencing Wudhu.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The hands should be washed up to the wrists three times.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The mouth should be rinsed three times and a miswâk should be used.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] If there is no miswâk, a thick cloth or fore-finger can be used to remove dirt.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] If not fasting, the mouth should be gargled thoroughly; if fasting, it should not be gargled thoroughly to avoid swallowing water.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The nose should be rinsed three times and cleaned with the left hand; fasting individuals should not let water go beyond the soft-bone of the nose.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The face should be washed three times from the hairline to below the chin and from one ear-lobe to the other, ensuring all areas are wet.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The right hand should be washed up to and including the elbows, followed by the left hand.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Khilâl of the fingers should be made by passing the fingers of one hand through the fingers of the other hand.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Any rings or jewelry on the fingers should be removed to ensure no part is left dry.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Masah of the head should be made by passing wet hands over the head.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Masah of the ears should be done by inserting forefingers into the ears and making masah of the back of the ear-lobes with thumbs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Masah of the neck should be made with the back of the fingers of both hands, but masah of the fore-neck/throat is prohibited.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Fresh water is not needed for masah of the ears; leftover water from the head is sufficient.
